stable.notes: The ledger bar now sits under the figure — a nameplate at the character's feet — instead of riding its head. Character on top, bar and counted caption beneath, and hovering still cross-fades the bar into the RUNNING, DONE, and WAITING pills in the same slot. Both rows ride the panel's fixed bottom edge, so nothing moves when the title card, actions, or session lists unfold above the figure. Everything else in 0.5.145 — the tight current-pose footprint, ledger vocabulary, completion chips, terminal jump, Miles Windu V15.3, character speed — is unchanged. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
